classes.name: Group Config Loader
classes.description: Loads the initial configuration settings for the trading group, establishing base parameters.

classes.name: Strategy Parser
classes.description: Parses the defined trading strategy to understand entry, exit, and risk management rules.

classes.name: Return Target Group
classes.description: Returns the initial group of target symbols or assets to be evaluated by the strategy.

classes.name: Trade Log Template
classes.description: Initializes the template structure for logging all trade activities and events.

classes.name: Trade Pool
classes.description: Manages the pool of active and pending trades, keeping track of their current status.

classes.name: Normalizing trade symbol states
classes.description: Standardizes the state and format of trade symbols to ensure consistency across the system.

classes.name: Time Filter
classes.description: Applies time-based restrictions to prevent trading during highly volatile or illiquid periods.

classes.name: Risk Filter
classes.description: Evaluates potential trades against predefined risk limits (e.g., max drawdown, exposure).

classes.name: Return Target Group (w/ filters)
classes.description: Outputs the refined list of target symbols after all pre-trade filters have been applied.

classes.name: Fetch Data
classes.description: Retrieves real-time market data (price, volume, order book) for the target symbols.

classes.name: Indicator processor
classes.description: Calculates technical indicators (e.g., RSI, MACD, Z-Score) based on the fetched market data.

classes.name: Strategy Manager -> Strategy Runner
classes.description: The core engine that evaluates indicator signals against strategy rules to generate trade decisions.

classes.name: Return Target Group (w/ states)
classes.description: Provides the final list of actionable targets along with their calculated states and signals.

classes.name: Position Sizing
classes.description: Determines the optimal trade size based on account equity, risk tolerance, and stop-loss distance.

classes.name: Trade Manager
classes.description: Executes the trade orders and continuously monitors open positions for exit conditions.

classes.name: TradeJournal
classes.description: Records the final outcome, execution details, and PnL of closed trades for historical analysis.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics
classes.description: Calculates overall system performance statistics (e.g., win rate, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown).

classes.name: SystemOrchestrator
classes.description: The master controller that coordinates the execution flow between all different phases and components.

classes.name: EventLoop
classes.description: The continuous loop that drives the system, processing market ticks and triggering evaluations.

classes.name: StateBroadcaster
classes.description: Publishes system state changes and trade events to external listeners or UI dashboards.
